lines: I drift away, a disembodied soul.
There seems to be nowhere to go.
It feels like I've obtained the wings of a beautiful butterfly.
My heart separates, a disembodied soul.
I feel the touch of the spring breeze.
I was watching the sun, just a little.
I drift away, a disembodied soul.
I want to go all the way to the sea.
It seems the autumn sunlight is hidden by sorrow.
My body separates, a disembodied soul.
Perhaps I will sway on the spring wind.
Like a painting where the paint overflows.
Lend me your oar.
Just to row as if in sorrow.
Know my anchor.
Waves, don't stop.
The unknown person I feared.
The one who laughed at me.
I wish I could die from the beauty of the waves.
I separate, a disembodied soul.
I headed toward the sea.
There was a me who had forgotten my body.
Lend me your oar.
Just to die unnamed, staying as such.
Know my voice.
Waves, don't stop.
My voice, go.
Become a thousand birds that swallow the sea.
Know my pain.
Waves.
Lend me your oar.
Just to row as if in sorrow.
Know my anchor.
Waves, don't stop.
Don't stop.
